title: General Call for Papers — CASTE: A Global Journal on Social Exclusion
host: CASTE: A Global Journal on Social Exclusion (Brandeis University Library)
theme: Caste and caste-like systems of marginalization and inter-generational oppression of religious, racial, and cultural minorities globally
description: CASTE: A Global Journal on Social Exclusion (also referred to as J-CASTE), published via Brandeis University Library in collaboration with the Center for Global Development and Sustainability at Brandeis University's Heller School, issues a standing/general call for papers on caste and caste-like systems of exclusion worldwide. The announcement text refers to 'forthcoming issues in 2021 through 2024,' which is stale relative to the extraction date; no current specific submission deadline is stated on the page, so this is treated as a rolling call. The journal states it charges no publication fees.

eligibility.notes: Rolling/general call; no specific deadline given on the page. The Editorial Team welcomes submissions from both established and emerging scholars, policy officials, and practitioners.

fees.source_quote: J-CASTE is a free Open Access journal with no publication fees.

standing_signals.signal: Editorial Advisory Board of 30 leading scholars from 10 countries
Published via Brandeis University Library in collaboration with the Center for Global Development and Sustainability, Heller School, Brandeis University

freshness.note: The call was posted on 27 June 2021 and invites papers for issues 2021 through 2024. No newer call was found on the page.
